Portuense — Rome, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Portuense is a mixed residential-commercial corridor along the historic Via Portuense, linking central Rome toward Trastevere and the southwestern suburbs. Recent local press documented a major police operation dismantling a large illegal squat/black-market compound in the area, the police closure of a nightlife venue amid resident complaints, and a run of nighttime car-stripping incidents shared with neighboring Marconi. By day it is an ordinary busy Roman street of shops and traffic; the documented issues are night-time and localized rather than a generalized danger.
